slides.sub: Close to 11.5 miles of trails in one wildlife refuge. Start with these 3.
slides.source: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service, Great Swamp NWR (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Helen C. Fenske Visitor Center
slides.body: Start here. Learn the refuge's history and see where wildlife is showing up today.
slides.source: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service, Great Swamp NWR (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Wildlife Observation Center
slides.body: The walking stop. Walk the boardwalks and watch from the blinds. No pets on the boardwalks or trails.
slides.source: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service, Great Swamp NWR (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Pleasant Plains Road
slides.body: The slow stop. Drive it slowly and look for wildlife from your car. Or bring your bike.
slides.source: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service, Great Swamp NWR (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: One Saturday in Harding
slides.tip: Near the swamp? Check the home's flood zone on FEMA's free map before you offer.
slides.source: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service; FEMA Flood Map Service Center (Nov. 2026)
